subject: Structural Penetration Sleeves Clash with Post-Tensioned Tendons at Shear Wall SW-04
technicalQuestion: Drawing S-204 indicates vertical post-tensioned tendon anchorages exactly at the level required for the 450mm chilled water supply and return sleeves. Can the risers be offset by 650mm to Grid D/7.5 without impacting the fire-rated shaft integrity?
location: Energy Center B3, Shear Wall SW-04
recipient: Eng. Tariq Al-Mansoor (Dar Al-Handasah Structural Lead)
consultantResponse: Offset of 650mm toward Grid D/7.5 is structurally acceptable provided 2-hour intumescent collar and rockwool firestopping is maintained in accordance with UL System W-L-1054.
